Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for mid-September 2021

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—General availability updates for mid-September 2021 

In mid-September 2021, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Azure SQL Managed Instance is now available under the Azure Resource in Terraform registry
